basics.name: Mark Cheli
basics.label: Director, Product Operations & Strategy · Onshape (PTC)
basics.summary: I'm the director of Onshape's Product Operations & Strategy team at PTC. The team handles the planning and review cycle for the product org, product analytics, the rollout of AI tools across R&D, localization, and a few internal tools. I came up through engineering and still write code when it's the fastest way to get something done. Outside work I run a homelab and build small apps on it.

work.name: PTC — Onshape
work.summary: Director of a small product operations team inside Onshape, PTC's cloud CAD product. The team's job is to keep the product org planned, measured and equipped: the planning cycle, product analytics, AI tooling for engineering, localization, and internal tools.
highlights: Planning: the product org's annual planning and ongoing review cycle.
Analytics: product analytics and the data warehouse that product and go-to-market teams work from.
AI adoption: the rollout of AI development tools across R&D, and the guidelines and governance that go with it.
Localization: localization operations for the product.
Hands-on: internal tools and integrations, built in-house when that's the fastest route.
2022: interim head of business operations for the Onshape business unit.
